title: maya-singh-misc-todo-2026-03-04
content:
Quick scratchpad / TODOs - 2026-03-04

PRIORITIES
- Finish canary rollout notes for model-v2 (need config snippet + rollback plan) — due EOD Thu
- JIRA-4578: investigate token accounting mismatch on dedicated instances (repro steps, logs)

TODOS (work)
- Outline canary plan: scope, metric thresholds, monitoring hooks
  - metric list: p50 latency, p95 latency, avg token cost, failed requests%
  - TODO: add trace link template to runbook (ask SRE for sampling rate)
- Quick test: run small batch job against staging-dedicated pool (use batch size=8, seq=1024)
  - check kv-cache warmup time
- Follow up with Avery on autoscale policy defaults (min/max GPUs, cooldown)
- Draft email to ops about private deployment onboarding checklist

PERSONAL / ERRANDS
- Return Amazon: wrong charger (drop-off by Friday)
- Grocery: eggs, almond milk, spinach, coffee pods
- Schedule dentist appointment (prefer Wed afternoon)

MEETING NOTES (quick)
- 9:30 sync with product: agree on rollout metric thresholds, add canary duration = 4h
- 11:00 call w/ customer success re: Dedicated trial feedback: request logs retention increase

RANDOM/IDEAS
- Consider adding a simple "cost budget" label to routes so billing alerts can be tied to app owners
- Could we expose per-request quantization hint (fast path for low-priority routes)? jot down for design doc

SNIPPETS / COMMANDS
- staging pool test command (pseudo):
  curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_TOKEN" 
    -d '{"model":"redwood-v2", "prompt":"<small batch test>", "max_tokens":64}'

LINKS / REFS
- Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/CONFLUENCE-1248 (canary-runbook draft)
- JIRA-4578 (token accounting)
- Slack thread: #dedicated-autoscale (ask Avery for thread link)

NOTES TO SELF
- Keep this doc minimal — move formal plan to Drive > product/rollouts once consolidated
- If blocked on logs, escalate to SRE with timestamped example requests

end of scratchpad
